S:
# Find process name(s) for the document whose description/title exactly matches 'Travel to Brazil'.
# We assume table_1 holds documents, table_2 processes, table_3 document-process links, already materialized into
# documents, processes, and document_process_links respectively by the materializer.

query = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT d.document_id,
       p.process_id,
       p.process_name
FROM documents d
JOIN document_process_links l
  ON l.document_id = d.document_id
JOIN processes p
  ON p.process_id = l.process_id
WHERE d.document_description = 'Travel to Brazil'
"""

_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, query)
